# LiveStash v1.0.0 - Table of Contents

Library that fixes problem of losing state on LiveView reconnects

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://live-stash.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [Welcome to LiveStash](https://live-stash.hexdocs.pm/welcome.md)
- [Example](https://live-stash.hexdocs.pm/example.md)

- Adapters
  - [Browser memory](https://live-stash.hexdocs.pm/browser_memory.md)
  - [ETS](https://live-stash.hexdocs.pm/ets.md)
  - [Mnesia](https://live-stash.hexdocs.pm/mnesia.md)
  - [Redis](https://live-stash.hexdocs.pm/redis.md)
  - [Custom Adapters](https://live-stash.hexdocs.pm/adapters.md)

## Modules

- [LiveStash](https://live-stash.hexdocs.pm/LiveStash.md): Main public API for stashing and recovering `Phoenix.LiveView` assigns.
- [LiveStash.Adapter](https://live-stash.hexdocs.pm/LiveStash.Adapter.md): Behaviour for storage backends used by `LiveStash`.
- [LiveStash.Adapters.BrowserMemory](https://live-stash.hexdocs.pm/LiveStash.Adapters.BrowserMemory.md): A client-side stash that persists data in the browser's memory.
- [LiveStash.Adapters.ETS](https://live-stash.hexdocs.pm/LiveStash.Adapters.ETS.md): A server-side stash that persists data in the server's memory.
- [LiveStash.Adapters.Mnesia](https://live-stash.hexdocs.pm/LiveStash.Adapters.Mnesia.md): A server-side stash that persists data in Mnesia.
- [LiveStash.Adapters.Redis](https://live-stash.hexdocs.pm/LiveStash.Adapters.Redis.md): A server-side stash that persists data in Redis.
